title: dactylorchis incarnata var. serotina
intro: Dactylorchis incarnata var. serotina, commonly known as the lady's slipper orchid, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the orchid family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorchis incarnata var. serotina include soothing and calming effects, making it useful for treating anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
